content.value_statement: CookMode V2 teams need accurate answers about where features live and how data moves. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to document the implementation without proposing changes.
actual_capabilities: Maps CookMode V2 architecture, including React, Pico CSS, Supabase, and hooks.
Explains component flow from App.js through recipe cards, modals, and image viewing.
Documents data flow between local state, optimistic updates, Supabase persistence, and realtime sync.
Identifies key directories and files used by components, hooks, utilities, constants, styles, and schema.
Produces factual feature summaries with what, where, how, and interaction sections.
Summarizes recent project context such as Pico CSS migration and removed features.
limitations: It focuses on CookMode V2 and is not a general recipe application assistant.
It avoids improvement suggestions unless the user explicitly asks for them.
It depends on accessible project files for exact line numbers and current implementation details.
It does not run tests or verify runtime behavior by itself.

use_cases.title: Onboard New Contributors
use_cases.description: Create a concise current-state map of the CookMode V2 structure, component roles, and data flow.

use_cases.title: Answer Implementation Questions
use_cases.description: Find where a feature is implemented and explain how related files work together.

use_cases.title: Prepare Product Documentation
use_cases.description: Translate implementation details into factual notes for planning, support, or operations teams.

prompt_templates.title: Find a Feature
prompt_templates.prompt: Use CookMode V2 Source of Truth to show where recipe scaling is implemented. Include file paths and line numbers.

prompt_templates.title: Explain Data Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to explain how recipe status changes move from the UI to Supabase and back to clients.

prompt_templates.title: Map Component Interactions
prompt_templates.prompt: Document how App.js, RecipeGrid.js, RecipeModal.js, Lightbox.js, and the custom hooks interact for modal display.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Current-State Map
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a current-state technical map for recipe order counts. Include what exists, where it exists, how it works, and interactions. Do not recommend changes.

output: A feature summary naming the RecipeModal slider, scaling utility, and order count state.
A Where section with relevant file paths and line references.
A How section explaining slider updates, scaling math, and rendering.

output_examples.input: Explain the Supabase data flow for recipe status.
output: A factual flow from UI state changes to Supabase persistence.
Notes about optimistic local updates and realtime subscription behavior.
Related component and hook names for follow-up inspection.
A summary of Pico CSS usage and semantic HTML preferences.
A list of recent styling changes and removed Tailwind usage.
Boundaries that separate current facts from requested improvement ideas.

best_practices: Ask for a specific feature, component, hook, or data flow when possible.
Request file paths and line numbers when you need implementation evidence.
State explicitly when you want improvement ideas, because the default mode is documentation only.
anti_patterns: Use it for speculative redesign work without asking for recommendations.
Expect verified line numbers when the related source files are unavailable.
Ask it to invent missing implementation details or ignore repository evidence.

faq.question: What does this skill document?
faq.answer: It documents the current CookMode V2 implementation, including architecture, files, components, hooks, data flow, and recent project context.

faq.question: Does it suggest improvements?
faq.answer: No. It avoids recommendations, refactors, and critiques unless the user explicitly requests them.

faq.question: Can it cite exact files and lines?
faq.answer: Yes, when the relevant project files are available to the agent for inspection.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Is it limited to CookMode V2?
faq.answer: Yes. Its source material and instructions are specific to the CookMode V2 project.

faq.question: Does it execute commands?
faq.answer: No. The skill file provides documentation instructions and Markdown examples, not executable scripts.
